paragraphs: We were founded in September 2020, backed by capital provided by GPC Partners Investments (SPV III) LP ("GPC Fund"), a private equity fund managed by Gallatin Point Capital LLC ("Gallatin Point"), and our strategic partner, AmFam, to take advantage of favorable pricing environments, and to address a growing and unmet demand from brokers and policyholders for specialized insurance solutions and quality service in complex lines of business. Our principal objective is to create and sustain superior returns for our stockholders by generating consistent, underwriting profits across our product offerings and through all market cycles, while prudently managing capital.

We offer commercial specialty property and casualty ("P&C") insurance products to policyholders that vary in size, industry and complexity, focusing on casualty, professional liability, and healthcare liability risks. Our products are delivered through two complementary underwriting models designed to support sustainable and profitable growth across market cycles: a "craft" model for large, complex, higher-severity risks, and a "digital" model for smaller, simpler, and scalable business.

Our craft underwriting model, Bowhead's foundation, relies on experienced underwriters who apply deep technical expertise and long-standing broker relationships to deliver tailored solutions for complex, non-standard, and higher-severity risks. Our digital underwriting model, including Baleen Specialty and other small-business offerings, a capability we call "express", emphasizes speed, consistency, and disciplined decision making through clear appetites, standardized products, and technology-enabled execution for small risks—without compromising underwriting discipline. While Baleen Specialty targets small, distressed, or hard-to-place risks with more restrictive coverage, our express offerings enhance Bowhead's existing products by simplifying the submission, underwriting, and servicing for small and mid-sized accounts.

Our policies are primarily written on a non-admitted, or excess and surplus lines ("E&S") basis, which is free of rate and policy form restrictions, and provides the flexibility to rapidly adjust to emerging market opportunities. We distribute our products through carefully selected relationships with leading distribution partners in both the wholesale and retail markets.

The policies we write are issued on AmFam paper under their own name through our wholly-owned managing general agency subsidiary, Bowhead Specialty Underwriters, Inc. ("BSUI"), in exchange for a ceding fee ("Ceding Fee"), and reinsured 100% to Bowhead Insurance Company, Inc. ("BICI"), our wholly-owned insurance company subsidiary. This mutually beneficial partnership with AmFam has enabled us to grow quickly, but prudently, to take advantage of favorable market conditions, and allows us to deploy capital efficiently.

We are a nimble, remote-friendly organization that is able to attract best-in-class talent nationwide, who are committed to operational excellence and superior service. We are led by a highly experienced and respected underwriting team with a disciplined approach to underwriting and decades of individual, successful underwriting experience. We are supported by a collaborative culture that spans all functions of our business, which allows us to provide a consistent, positive experience for all our partners. We believe that our current market opportunity, differentiated expertise, relationships, culture and leadership team position us well to continue to grow our business profitably.
We currently offer underwriting solutions to a wide variety of businesses across four underwriting divisions: Casualty, Professional Liability, Healthcare Liability, and Baleen Specialty.

Our Casualty division provides tailored solutions on a primary and excess basis and consists of a team of experienced underwriters with nationwide capabilities who excel at handling complex risks. We specialize in general liability coverage, provided through a wholesale-only distribution channel, which protects a company against liability arising from bodily injury, personal injury or property damage, for risks in the construction, distribution, manufacturing, real estate, public entity and hospitality segments and also consider underwriting risks in a broader range of industries. We also have environmental liability expertise, offering contractor and site pollution liability coverage on a primary and excess basis through specialized wholesale and retail distributors. Our Casualty division products are currently delivered through our craft underwriting model.

Our Professional Liability division provides underwriting solutions on both an admitted and E&S basis for standard and nonstandard risks, and writes a broad variety of entities, including publicly traded and privately held financial institutions as well as not-for-profit organizations. We distribute this business through wholesale and retail channels. We offer management liability products, including directors and officers liability, errors and omissions liability, employment practices liability, fiduciary liability, fidelity liability and miscellaneous professional liability, crime insurance, and cyber liability. We provide primary coverage and excess coverage for most of our Professional Liability products. Our Professional Liability division products are primarily delivered through our craft underwriting model. In 2025, we began to deliver small cyber liability and miscellaneous professional liability products through our digital underwriting model, the premiums of which are reported as "Express" in the gross written premiums by underwriting model table below.

Bowhead's Healthcare Liability division focuses solely on healthcare entities to provide tailored solutions. We offer professional and general liability coverage, as well as management liability coverage, across four major healthcare segments—hospitals, miscellaneous medical facilities, senior care providers, and managed care organizations—through select wholesale and retail channels. Our Healthcare Liability division products are currently delivered through our craft underwriting model.

Baleen Specialty is a technology-powered underwriting operation that specializes in small to mid-sized risks that are not eligible in the admitted market. We have a wholesale-only distribution model and offer exclusively non-admitted products. Currently, we offer general liability products for two segments – construction and real estate, and our coverage offering is restrictive, as customers are typically distressed or hard-to-place. Typically, small to mid-sized E&S risks are placed through binding authorities managed by wholesale brokers. Using technology, Baleen Specialty offers an alternative to the binding authorities by quickly intaking, evaluating, and responding, with either declinations or a quote, in a reliable manner. Baleen Specialty's appetite will continue to expand to meet the evolving needs of our wholesale broker partners. Our Baleen Specialty division products are delivered through our digital underwriting model.

Our financial condition and results of operations could be materially adversely affected if we do not accurately assess our underwriting risk.
Competition for business in our industry is intense.

A decline in AmFam's financial strength rating or financial size category may adversely affect our financial condition and results of operations.

Because our business depends on insurance retail agents, brokers and wholesalers, we are exposed to certain risks arising out of our reliance on these distribution channels that could adversely affect our results.
We rely on a select group of brokers, and such relationships may not continue.
Our losses and loss expense reserves may be inadequate to cover our actual losses, which could have a material adverse effect on our financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.
We rely on third-party data, and inaccuracies in such data could adversely impact our ability to estimate losses and manage risks.
Outward reinsurance is a key part of our strategy, subjecting us to the credit risk of our reinsurers and may not be available, affordable or adequate to protect against losses.
Our reinsurers may not reimburse us for claims on a timely basis, or at all, which may materially adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.
We may act based on inaccurate or incomplete information regarding the accounts we underwrite.
Our failure to accurately and timely pay claims could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects.
Excessive risk taking could negatively affect our financial condition and business.
If actual renewals of our existing contracts do not meet expectations, our gross written premiums in future years and our future results of operations could be materially adversely affected.
Cyber threats are an evolving risk area affecting not only the specific cyber insurance market but also the liability coverage we provide which may adversely affect us.
Changes in accounting practices and future pronouncements may materially affect our reported financial results and business.
We may not be able to effectively start up or integrate new product opportunities.
Performance of our investment portfolio is subject to a variety of investment risks that may adversely affect our financial results.
paragraphs: A description of the risks and uncertainties associated with our business is set for below. You should carefully consider the following information about these risks, together with the other information contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including our financial statements and the notes thereto, and "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations." If any of the following risks actually occur, our business, financial condition or results of operations may be materially adversely affected. In such case, the trading price of our common stock could decline and you may lose all or part of your investment. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial also may impair our business operations.
This summary provides an overview of the risks we face and should not be considered a substitute for the more fulsome risk factors discussed immediately following this summary.
•Our financial condition and results of operations could be materially adversely affected if we do not accurately assess our underwriting risk.
•Competition for business in our industry is intense.
•Inability to maintain our strategic relationship with AmFam would materially adversely affect our business.
•A decline in AmFam's financial strength rating or financial size category may adversely affect our financial condition and results of operations.

Gross written premiums are the amounts received, or to be received, for insurance policies written or assumed by us during a specific period of time without reduction for policy acquisition costs, reinsurance costs or other deductions. The volume of our gross written premiums in any given period is generally influenced by new business submissions, binding of new business submissions into policies, renewals of existing policies and average size and premium rate of bound policies.

Ceded written premiums are the amount of gross written premiums ceded to reinsurers. We enter into reinsurance contracts to limit our exposure to potential losses. The volume of our ceded written premiums is impacted by the level of our gross written premiums and any decision we make to increase or decrease retention levels and policy limits.
Net written premiums are gross written premiums less ceded written premiums.

Net earned premiums represent the earned portion of our net written premiums. Our insurance policies generally have a term of one year but occasionally could be as long as ten years, and premiums are earned pro rata over the term of the policy.

Net losses and loss adjustment expenses represent the costs incurred for insured losses, which include losses under a claims made or occurrence policy, paid or unpaid, expenses for settling claims, such as attorneys' fees, investigation, appraisal, adjustment, defense costs and a portion of operating expenses allocated to claim resolution, net of any losses ceded to reinsurers. Net losses and loss adjustment expenses also include a provision for claims that have occurred but have not yet been reported to the insurer. These expenses are a function of the amount and type of insurance contracts the Company writes and the loss experience associated with the underlying coverage. In general, our net losses and loss adjustment expenses are affected by:
•the occurrence, frequency and severity of claims associated with the particular types of insurance contracts that we write;
•the mix of business written by us; •changes in the legal or regulatory environment related to the business we write;

paragraphs: 本公司於2020年9月成立，由GPC Partners Investments (SPV III) LP ("GPC Fund")，一間由Gallatin Point Capital LLC ("Gallatin Point") 管理的私募股權基金，以及我們的戰略夥伴AmFam 提供資金支持，以利用有利的價格環境，並回應來自經紀人與保單持有人對專業保險解決方案與複雜業務領域中優質服務日益增長且未被滿足的需求。本公司主要目標為透過在產品組閤中產生一致的承保利潤，並在所有市場週期中創造並維持對股東的優越回報，同時謹慎管理資本。
我們提供商業專業財產與責任（"P&C"）保險產品給保單持有人，這些保單持有人規模、產業與複雜度各不相同，我們專注於意外責任、專業責任與醫療責任風險。我們的產品透過兩種互補的承保模式來提供，以支持在不同市場週期中可持續且獲利的成長：一種是用來處理大型、複雜、高風險的"craft"模式，以及一種用來處理較小、較簡單且可擴展業務的"digital"模式。

我們的craft承保模式，為Bowhead的基礎，依賴經驗豐富的承保人，運用深厚的技術專業知識與長期的經紀人關係，為複雜、非標準及高風險的風險提供個性化解決方案。我們的digital承保模式，包括Baleen Specialty及其他小型企業產品，我們稱為"express"的能力，強調速度、一致性與嚴謹的決策，透過明確的承保範圍、標準化產品與科技驅動的執行，處理小型風險—而不影響承保紀律。雖然Baleen Specialty針對小型、處於困境或難以置放的風險，提供較為嚴格的保障，但我們的express產品則透過簡化提交、承保與服務流程，增強Bowhead現有產品，以服務小型與中型帳戶。
我們的保單主要以非承認（或過度與補充線（"E&S"））方式出具，這種方式不受價格與保單形式限制，並提供靈活性以迅速調整至新興市場機會。我們透過精心選擇的關係，與 Wholesale 和 Retail 市場中的領導分銷夥伴合作來分銷產品。

我們出具的保單是以AmFam的名義，透過我們全資擁有之管理總代理子公司Bowhead Specialty Underwriters, Inc. ("BSUI")，以換取分出費用（"Ceding Fee"）的方式發行，並完全再保險至我們全資擁有之保險公司子公司Bowhead Insurance Company, Inc. ("BICI")。與AmFam的這項互利合作關係使我們得以快速且謹慎地成長，以利用有利的市場條件，並允許我們有效率地運用資本。
我們是一個靈活且遠距友好的組織，能夠吸引全國範圍內的頂級人才，這些人才致力於運營卓越與優越的服務。我們由一支經驗豐富且受尊重的承保團隊領導，具備嚴謹的承保方法與數十年的個人成功承保經驗。我們的業務各部門之間擁有協作的文化，使我們能為所有合作夥伴提供一致且正面的體驗。我們相信，我們目前的市場機會、差異化的專業知識、關係、文化與領導團隊，使我們有良好的條件持續以獲利的方式成長業務。
我們目前為多種企業提供承保解決方案，分屬四個承保部門：意外責任、專業責任、醫療責任與Baleen Specialty。

我們的意外責任部門提供主要與過度承保的個性化解決方案，並由一羣經驗豐富的承保人組成，具備全國範圍的執行能力，擅長處理複雜風險。我們專注於一般責任保險，透過僅限 Wholesale 的分銷渠道提供，這類保險可保護公司免於因身體傷害、個人傷害或財產損壞而產生的責任，適用於建築、分銷、製造、不動產、公共機構與餐飲業等領域的風險，並考量更廣泛產業的承保風險。我們也具備環境責任專業知識，透過專門的 Wholesale 與 Retail 分銷商，提供承包商與場地污染責任保險，以主要與過度承保的方式。我們的意外責任部門產品目前透過我們的craft承保模式來提供。

本公司專業責任業務部門提供承保解決方案，包含已承認與E&S（Excess and Surplus）方式，用以承保標準與非標準風險，並承保廣泛的企業類型，包括上市與非上市的金融機構以及非營利組織。本公司透過批發與零售通路來銷售此業務。本公司提供管理責任產品，包括董事與高階主管責任、錯誤與遺漏責任、就業實務責任、受託人責任、忠誠責任、忠實責任與其他專業責任產品、犯罪保險與網路責任保險。本公司對大多數專業責任產品提供首期與過失承保。本公司專業責任業務部門產品主要透過本公司手工承保模式進行銷售。2025年，本公司開始透過數位承保模式銷售小型網路責任與其他專業責任產品，其 premiums 會在下述按承保模式分類的總寫 premiums 表格中標示為 "Express"。
Bowhead 的醫療責任業務部門專注於醫療機構，提供客製化解決方案。本公司提供專業與一般責任保險，以及管理責任保險，針對四大醫療領域—醫院、其他醫療設施、長照機構與醫療管理機構—透過選擇性的批發與零售通路進行銷售。本公司醫療責任業務部門產品目前透過本公司手工承保模式進行銷售。

Baleen Specialty 是一間以科技為動力的承保業務，專門處理未被已承認市場接受的小至中型風險。本公司採用僅限批發的銷售模式，並 exclusively 提供非已承認產品。目前，本公司提供兩大領域的一般責任保險—建築與不動產，且本公司提供的保障範圍較為限制，因為客戶通常為處於困境或難以承保的企業。通常，小至中型 E&S 風險會透過批發經紀人管理的承保權進行銷售。透過科技，Baleen Specialty 提供一種替代方案，能快速受理、評估與回應，並以拒絕或報價的方式進行，以可靠的方式進行。Baleen Specialty 的承保範圍將持續擴張，以符合本公司批發經紀人夥伴的不斷演進需求。本公司 Baleen Specialty 部門產品透過本公司數位承保模式進行銷售。

paragraphs: 有關我們截至2024年12月31日之年度結果，以及2024年12月31日與2023年12月31日年度之比較，請參閱我們2024年12月31日年度報告（Form 10-K）之「Part II, Item 7. 管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析」，該報告已於2025年2月27日提交至美國證券交易委員會（SEC）。
我們於2020年9月成立，由GPC Fund（由Gallatin Point管理之私募股權基金）與我們戰略夥伴AmFam提供資金支持，以利用有利的價格環境，並回應經紀人與保單持有人對專業保險解決方案與複雜業務領域中優質服務日益增長且未被滿足的需求。我們的主要目標是為股東創造並維持優越回報，透過我們產品組合的持續承保獲利，以及在所有市場週期中，謹慎管理資本。
我們提供商業專業財產與責任（P&C）保險產品給保單持有人，這些保單持有人規模、產業與複雜度各不相同，專注於意外、專業責任與醫療責任風險。我們的產品透過兩種補充性的承保模式來提供，以支持在不同市場週期中可持續且獲利的成長：一種是針對大型、複雜、高風險的「craft」模式，另一種是針對較小、較簡單且可擴展業務的「digital」模式。

我們的「craft」承保模式，為Bowhead的基礎，依賴經驗豐富的承保人，運用深厚的技術專業知識與長期經紀人關係，為複雜、非標準、高風險的業務提供個性化解決方案。我們的「digital」承保模式，包括Baleen Specialty及其他中小企業產品，我們稱此為「express」，強調速度、一致性與嚴謹的決策，透過明確的承保範圍、標準化產品與科技驅動的執行，處理小型風險，而不影響承保紀律。雖然Baleen Specialty針對小型、處於困境或難以投保的風險，提供較為嚴格的保障，但我們的「express」產品則透過簡化提交、承保與服務流程，增強Bowhead現有產品，以服務中小型客戶。
我們的保單主要以非承認（E&S）方式發行，這種方式不受價格與保單形式限制，並提供靈活性以迅速適應新興市場機會。我們透過精心挑選的關係，與 Wholesale 及 Retail 市場中的領導分銷夥伴合作來分銷產品。
我們所發行的保單是以AmFam名義，透過我們的管理總代理BSUI發行，並以Ceding Fee為對價，並完全再保險至我們的 wholly-owned 保險公司子公司BICI。與AmFam的這項互利合作關係使我們得以快速且謹慎地成長，利用有利的市場條件，並能有效運用資本。
我們建立了一個靈活且遠端友好的組織，能吸引全國各地的頂尖人才，這些人才致力於運營卓越與優質服務。我們由一支經驗豐富且受尊重的承保團隊領導，具備嚴謹的承保方法與數十年的個人成功承保經驗。我們的業務各部門擁有協作的文化，使我們能為所有合作夥伴提供一致且正面的體驗。我們相信，我們目前的市場機會、差異化的專業知識、關係、文化與領導團隊，使我們能持續以獲利的方式成長業務。
已承保的總 premiums 是指在特定期間內，我們所寫或承擔的保險保單所收到或應收到的金額，不計減政策取得成本、再保險成本或其他扣除項目。我們在任何特定期間的已承保總 premiums 通常受新業務提交數量、新業務提交轉為保單數量、現有保單續約數量以及已承保保單的平均規模與 premiums 率的影響。
轉讓已寫入保費為已寫入保費轉讓予再保險公司的金額。我們與再保險公司簽訂再保險契約，以限制我們對潛在損失的風險敞口。我們轉讓已寫入保費的數量受我們已寫入保費水準及我們決定提高或降低自留比例及保單責任上限的影響。
淨寫入保費為已寫入保費減去轉讓已寫入保費。
淨已賺取保費代表我們淨寫入保費中已賺取的部分。我們的保險契約通常為一年期，但偶爾可能長達十年，且保費會根據契約期間按比例賺取。

淨損失及損失調整費用代表為被保險損失所產生的成本，包括根據申報或發生基礎保單所產生的損失，無論是否已支付或未支付，以及解決索賠的費用，例如律師費用、調查、鑑價、調整、辯護費用及部分分配至索賠處理的營運費用，扣除轉讓予再保險公司的損失後的淨額。淨損失及損失調整費用亦包含對已發生但尚未向保險公司申報的索賠的備抵。這些費用取決於本公司所寫入的保險契約種類及與基礎保障相關的損失經驗。總體而言，我們的淨損失及損失調整費用受以下因素影響：
•特定類型保險契約所產生的索賠發生率、頻率及嚴重程度；
•本公司所寫入業務的組成；•與我們所從事業務相關的法律或法規環境的變動；

本公司依賴少數經紀人，這些關係可能無法持續。
我們的損失及損失費用準備金可能不足以覆蓋實際損失，這可能會對本公司財務狀況、營運成果及現金流造成重大不利影響。
我們依賴第三方資料，若這些資料不準確，可能會影響我們對損失的預估及風險管理能力。
向外投保再保險是本公司策略的重要組成部分，這會使我們面臨再保險公司的信用風險，且再保險可能無法取得、價格合理或足夠以抵禦損失。
我們的再保險公司可能無法及時或完全償付我們的聲請，這可能會對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大不利影響。
我們可能根據不正確或不完整之資訊進行業務操作。
我們未能準確且及時支付賠款，可能對本公司之業務、財務狀況、營運成果與前景造成重大且不利之影響。
過度風險行為可能對本公司之財務狀況與業務造成負面影響。
若現有契約之實際續約情況未達預期，將可能對本公司未來年度之毛寫 premiums 以及未來營運成果造成重大且不利之影響。
網路威脅為一持續演進之風險領域，不僅影響特定網路保險市場，亦可能影響本公司所提供之責任保險覆蓋範圍，進而對本公司造成不利影響。
會計準則之變更及未來之會計準則宣示，可能對本公司所報導之財務結果與業務造成重大影響。
本公司可能無法有效啟動或整合新產品機會。
本公司投資組合之表現受多種投資風險影響，可能對本公司財務結果造成不利影響。
paragraphs: 本公司業務所涉及之風險與不確定性說明如下。請謹慎考量下列風險資訊，並配合本年度10-K表報表中其他資訊，包括財務報表及其附註，以及「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析」。若有任何上述風險實際發生，將可能對本公司業務、財務狀況或營運成果造成重大不利影響。在此情況下，本公司普通股之交易價格可能下跌，您可能損失全部或部分投資。此外，尚有其他未為本公司所知或目前認為不重要之風險與不確定性，亦可能影響本公司業務營運。
此摘要提供本公司所面臨風險之概要，不得視為後續更詳細風險因素之替代。
